definitions.explanation: Colored pigments used for painting and drawing, such as watercolors, oil paints, or acrylic paints. A standard school supply in Japan.

examples.english: I painted a picture with paints.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りなく→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I ran out of red paint.

examples.japanese: ⟦{図工|ずこう}→図工：19698_zukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水彩|すいさい}→水彩：24163_suisai⟧{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{風景画|ふうけいが}→風景画：28196_fuukeiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いた→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
examples.english: During art class, I used watercolors to paint a landscape.

notes:
USAGE:
{絵|え}の{具|ぐ} is the general word for art paints. It is a standard item in Japanese school supplies, with ⟦{水彩|すいさい}→水彩：24163_suisai⟧{絵|え}の{具|ぐ} (watercolors) being the most common type used in elementary school art classes (⟦{図工|ずこう}→図工：19698_zukou⟧). The word ⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ here means "tool" or "material."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{水彩|すいさい}→水彩：24163_suisai⟧{絵|え}の{具|ぐ} (watercolor paints)
- {油|あぶら}{絵|え}の{具|ぐ} (oil paints)
- {絵|え}の{具|ぐ}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧ (paint set)
- {絵|え}の{具|ぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜる→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧ (to mix paints)
